criteria.name: correctness
criteria.description: Quick-add and empty-state actions use existing mutation flows and preserve real/mock behavior.

criteria.name: completeness
criteria.description: New-user onboarding, quick suggestions, manual fallback, and Explore empty action are all present.

criteria.name: edge_cases
criteria.description: Suggestions exclude existing user skills, do not render when editing is unavailable, and handle sparse teams.

criteria.name: craft
criteria.description: UI stays compact, mobile-first, and task-oriented without landing-page copy or visual clutter.
